label: Claude alone, then one review pass
run: c() { claude -p --output-format json --permission-mode dontAsk ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} --setting-sources "" --strict-mcp-config --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Edit,Write --allowedTools "Edit(/$PWD/**)"; }; c < "$SWE_PROMPT" && { printf 'Review the uncommitted change in the repository in the current folder against the issue below, as a strict code reviewer. Fix every real problem you find in it; change nothing else; do not commit.\n\n'; cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; } | c
